title: Hessdalen expedition in the early 1980s

tellings.quote:
First, uh, in the 1980s, early
1980s, we and you from Norway had this
huge expedition there and we could take
pictures of them. We can also see them
on radar once.

plain: In the early 1980s, a big expedition went to Hessdalen, a valley in Norway known for strange lights, and managed to photograph the lights and once to catch them on radar. Clas Svahn, a Swedish UFO researcher, tells Michels this as someone who took part, saying Swedish and Norwegian researchers ran it together.
